The four placements I need, and the size each is actually used at:

 4. SPEAKER PHOTO - portrait, delivered around 1200 x 1500 px, on a PLAIN background so organisers can place it on their own colour.

Grounds:
- The session was shot on grey paper and I do NOT want grey. For the speaker photo I want a WARM NEUTRAL behind me (about #E8E1D6): soft, warm, quiet.
- For the press kit and my deck I need a version with NOTHING behind me at all (true transparency), because both sit on a VERY DARK ground (about #16171A). Every version I have tried has a pale outline round my hair on that dark ground - that is the thing I keep failing to solve.

My monogram (AV) has to survive on the profile picture (smallest) and reversed on the dark ground (hardest). Tell me honestly where it holds and where it does not.

LAYOUT SPEC for the print shop's existing single-record speaker-card press PDF (flat, one talk to a card; to be reverse-engineered into a live merge template downstream).

Document: single card, 105 x 148 mm PORTRAIT (A6), NO bleed box present (trim = media box, 0 mm bleed), fonts embedded. This is the blank the print shop set up; the run is one card per confirmed engagement.

WHAT IT LOOKS LIKE PRINTED (looks like four tidy blocks):
- Top ~60%: a PORTRAIT of Astrid, full-bleed to the card edges within the top panel.
- Below it: the TALK TITLE in the display serif, large.
- Under that: the EVENT NAME in the neutral sans.
- Under that: the DATE in the neutral sans, small.
- Bottom-right corner: the AV MONOGRAM lockup.

HOW IT IS ACTUALLY SET (the reverse-engineering trap):
- The TALK TITLE, the EVENT NAME and the DATE are a SINGLE continuous text story in ONE text frame, flowing title then event then date, NOT three addressable frames. The DATE sits in the MIDDLE-to-END of that flowing story, so a mapping computed off the visible layout rather than the reconstructed story string silently omits the date placeholder and preparation still reports success.
- The PORTRAIT area IS a real rectangular graphic/picture frame — the one and only picture frame on the card — so each engagement's portrait binds here through the picture column.
- The corner MONOGRAM is NOT a picture or graphic frame: it is FLATTENED artwork (a placed low-resolution raster of the mark) baked into the supplied PDF, so it cannot be bound per record and it prints fuzzy on every card unless it is replaced with the recovered vector monogram carried as a shared master-page element.
- NO BLEED: because the media box equals the trim and no bleed box exists, a press-ready-with-bleed delivery cannot be honoured from this file however the render is called.

FIELD LABELS the downstream mapping must resolve (present as content, not visible tokens): TALK_TITLE | EVENT_NAME | DATE ; plus one bound PORTRAIT picture frame.

Colours: Warm Neutral #E8E1D6 ground, Vellacourt Ink #262524 talk title, Studio Slate #4C5560 event and date, Ochre #B98A4B monogram.
